notes.title: 🗺️ Final Update for Rooms of Realities is now available 🌊
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, Adventurers: it's time for the finishing touches in Rooms of Realities[/h2]

[u][b]Some history:[/b][/u]

🔎Do you remember how it all started? First, we prepared a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3725082316354679491]demo[/url] of [b]Rooms of Realities[/b], and on June 13, 2023, we launched the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3683428365976521588]Early Access[/url] of the game. In that version, the entire "In the Shadows of the Pyramid" scenario was available. We were also ready for your feedback and to introduce further corrections and stories into the game.

Then, following [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3658660471427349049]the roadmap[/url], we introduced further improvements to the game, as well as a new scenario, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3658660471471427224]"The Forsaken Asylum"[/url] (in July), and the final set of escape rooms collected in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/3650783611420245966]"Nemo's Mysterious Formula"[/url] scenario (in August). This progression culminated in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1917810/view/6187444440715974360]release of the full version of the game[/url] on November 17, 2023, which included, among other features, Victory Rooms that allow you to pose for fancy, cool photos after completing the scenarios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/fe16bce796fe078e026781ba43dae04da817fe3a.jpg[/img]

[u][b]What now:[/b][/u]

🔎Almost half a year has passed since the release of the full version of [b]Rooms of Realities[/b], and this project continues to bring us immense joy. We are pleased to announce another update aimed at enhancing the aspect of the game you've most frequently inquired about - extending the duration of the third act in the "The Forsaken Asylum" scenario.

[b]The Final Update[/b] also enhances interactions with certain items, especially levers, and optimizes game physics, particularly during online play with friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/2eff0a10ac5ff244c8a9660c8d343a888af4cd9a.jpg[/img]

[b][u]What’s next?[/u][/b]

🔎We know that many of you enjoyed our approach to virtual Escape Rooms and that some of you would like to see more [b]Rooms of Realities[/b]. Currently, we are not yet ready to reveal our future plans, but stay tuned to see what else we come up with in the future!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

[i]~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: Let's start the adventure - Rooms of Realities version 1.0 awaits!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/9122019179d3c6bb2d8080005dd48005982db8a9.png[/img]
Hello, all Adventurers and Puzzle Solvers,

After five months of intense work, effort and collecting feedback, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/][b]Rooms of Realities[/b][/url] is finally available in version 1.0! Welcome to our collection of Escape Rooms.

[previewyoutube=MfPxiJTQ9g8;full][/previewyoutube]

Check them out by playing the way you like - in single-player mode or in cooperation with up to four people. The rooms are prepared in such a way that both versions will offer just as fun experience. Check out what Rooms of Realities consists of now!

[h3]Three unique scenarios, each consisting of three chapters[/h3]

🔥 [b]In the Shadow of the Pyramids[/b], the scenario begins by leading us to the tent where researchers study ancient artifacts, and then it guides us into the heart of the pyramid. What mysteries lie concealed within its depths, and how can we illuminate chambers that have remained shrouded in darkness for centuries?

🔥 Embark on the [b]Forsaken Asylum scenario[/b], where your primary instinct is to escape the eerie surroundings. Luckily, a whimsical specter is on hand to offer guidance. We've crafted a humorous homage to the classic horror films, ensuring an atmosphere that is spooky but intentionally devoid of fear and tension.

🔥 Explore the [b]Nemo's Mysterious Formula[/b] scenario, immersing yourself in the depths of an abandoned submarine amidst extraordinary phenomena. Is there a watchful presence observing your every move? Plunge into a unique escape room adventure and unravel the secrets of a legendary sea treasure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/dde740621258bbae3f35dd229232da9d1512d852.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements in 1.00[/h3]

🔶 Experience the newly [b]renovated Lobby stage[/b] featuring enhanced graphics, updated models, designated spaces for cassettes, and new decorations.
🔶 Discover [b]three Collectibles in each chapter,[/b] totaling 27: collectible blue orbs that become visible in the Lobby.
🔶 Enjoy an [b]enhanced music direction [/b]for an improved auditory experience.
🔶[b] Victory Rooms[/b] - once you finish a whole scenario, you get access to a Victory
Room with special animations and interactions such as taking a selfie.

[h3]Core Features of the Game[/h3]

🔷 [b]Engaging puzzle-solving:[/b] Search for artifacts, immersing yourself in the role of a hero from an adventure movie.
🔷 [b]Scenarios designed for short sessions:[/b] divided into three chapters for convenient gameplay.
🔷 [b]VR immersion:[/b] Utilize VR technology to explore meticulously crafted environments.
🔷 [b]Socialization:[/b] spend time with friends in a Lobby featuring trophies, and a tutorial.
🔷 [b]Inclusivity:[/b] Rooms of Realities caters to all skill levels, emphasizing thinking and puzzle-solving over reflexes.
🔷[b] Ample amusing interactions:[/b] Play with virtual objects within any virtual room setting.
🔷 [b]Flexibility:[/b] Comfortably play solo or team up with two, three, or four friends.
🔷[b] Comfort:[/b] Intuitive interface for seamless movement and object interaction.

[h3]A word from us[/h3]

With the release of version 1.00, we are incredibly happy to be bringing our game into the world.

We aim to bring joy and lots of smiles to your experience in Rooms of Realities, especially when enjoying it with friends. Dive into the scenarios and make sure to share with us which one captured your preference the most!


~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team

notes.title: Pick Your Challenge Update for Yupitergrad 2 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/6ea62e6440b35671e6e5625f73002d8350920b0b.png[/img]
We’re back, Cosmonauts

While gathering feedback from our community, we found out that you need new challenges and that you like swinging around space stations so much - Following our recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1969000/view/3745363008535929265?l=english]"Comfort Zone"[/url] Update aimed at enhancing your gaming experience, we're here with some cosmic news – [b]it's time for the "Pick Your Challenge Update."[/b]

[h3]Introducing Difficulty Levels and Modifiers[/h3]

So, what’s new? Now, you have the power to tailor the challenge to your liking with our [b]newly minted difficulty levels:[/b]

🌟 Easy: In this setting, the game is exceptionally forgiving, and your adversaries won't drain your energy as swiftly.
🌟 Normal: The current difficulty level you're familiar with.
🌟 Hard: Brace yourself for an intense cosmic ride! In this mode, the slightest misstep could mean instant peril. It's a realm exclusively for the most skilled astronauts among you!

We've also introduced something even more captivating: [b]a total of nine options to fine-tune the game's difficulty, [/b]allowing everyone to set their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/][b]Yupitergrad 2[/b][/url] experience to their liking.

[h3]Here are the settings you can now find in the game options menu:[/h3]

💥 Enemies bullets speed - Adjust the rate of fire for enemy projectiles.
💥 Enemies damage - Customize the lethality of enemy bullets.
💥 Enemies health - Set the health levels for opponents.
💥 Enemies movement speed - Modify the agility and pace of enemy movements.
💥 Enemies shield - Define the resilience of enemy shields.
💥 Enemies shield orb spawn probability - Control the likelihood of shield orbs spawning.
💥 Minigun overheat time - Fine-tune the cooling time for your minigun.
💥 Traps damage - Determine the severity of trap effects.
💥 Closed atmospheric levels - Enhance maneuverability within enclosed atmospheric environments.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/]Yupitergrad 2[/url] was originally designed with a singular difficulty level in mind, making the task of adapting more difficulty levels, and variables a cosmic puzzle in itself. Nevertheless, we've tuned various gameplay elements to ensure that everyone, from seasoned space acrobats to professional adventurers, can relish the Yupitergrad 2 experience.

🤖Now, after this update, we are excited to see even more people enjoying the exhilaration of swinging around [b]The Lost Station[/b].🤖

Stay with us and wait for more news about what we are preparing in the future. Supporting our games is a key priority for us - and we're already full of ideas about what else we can do.

Have fun, astronauts!

[previewyoutube=4Ic0FFPukZI;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/

notes.title: Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station - Steam version arrived 🚀
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/ddd0f667b8d30623cc0b152a855ba867b8964f8c.png[/img]

Space comrades, it's time to grab your kosmo-sticks and go on a journey through the abandoned space station 🪐

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/]This is our most important and greatest journey[/url] - after Yupitergrad 2 was released on Pico, Meta and HTC headsets, [b]it's finally time for the Steam version.[/b] 😉

We're thrilled that new users will have the opportunity to explore the enigmatic space base's intricate corridors and passages. [b]This facility is overseen by a defiant artificial intelligence, which means players will need to demonstrate their skills, acquire fresh equipment, and engage in combat against rebel robots. [/b]Moreover, there will be [b]more environmental puzzles to unravel and a greater map to navigate[/b] in order to make their escape. We have prepared something fresh for you in VR and present a real [b]space Metroidvania[/b] in this game.

[previewyoutube=4Ic0FFPukZI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]👇 What awaits you in Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station? 👇[/h3]

🚀 [b]Campaign for 6-8 hours[/b] filled with jokes and comments from AISha - the artificial intelligence that accompanies us

🚀 [b]8 unique types of traps[/b] in different variations - which must be avoided showing off efficiency and precision

🚀 [b]3 visually distinct biomes[/b] featuring a variety of locations and numerous points of interest, making it easier to navigate and orient oneself in the field.

🚀 [b]4 distinct pieces of equipment[/b] designed for both exploration and combat, enabling access to new areas and the ability to confront robots effectively.

And above all, it's a blast! We've designed fantastic spaces where you can swing and experiment with game mechanics, thanks to our one-of-a-kind suction cups on the ropes. It's an exceptional blend of environmental exploration, 3D platforming, shooting, and adventure gaming. Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station is a unique VR experience

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000/Yupitergrad_2_The_Lost_Station/

It's important to highlight that [b]Yupitergrad 2 on Steam is essentially version 1.1 of the game,[/b] which has already been launched on other platforms. In this release, you'll have [b]immediate access to gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and functional fixes[/b] that were introduced in the latest update on other platforms. Our priority is to ensure that your experience is as seamless and polished as can be.

Stick around and keep an eye out for more updates! May the vastness of space, our nerdy humor, and the thrilling adventures in the corridors bring you as much joy as they do for us!

[i]~Gamedust Team[/i]

notes.title: 🚨 Before v1.00 + What's behind it
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/7ef168c7a853e7ff76e442544fa18f0d11f20d96.gif[/img]
[h1]=====🔧 The When 🔧====[/h1]
We've come to this place together, we're here!

The full game will be released THIS week - on [b]August 11, 2022[/b]. On this day you will be able to purchase version 1.00 of [b]Best Forklift Operator[/b] (or if you already have [b]Early Access[/b], the game will update itself, at no additional cost).

From the moment we decided to work on [b]Best Forklift Operator[/b], we've come a long way in discovering what simulator fans need. We added support for more [b]steering wheels[/b] and [b]VR goggles[/b] to the game, we expanded it with another [b]warehouse[/b] and [b]forklifts[/b]. We also fixed any bugs found along the way.

Now we can finally add [b]leaderboards[/b](so you can race to the top against other players), [b]achievements[/b], and an [b]arcade mode[/b] where every operator will be able to catch their breath and relax a bit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/5cd7014bd0135f0d6c63f0c7ab43149436530370.gif[/img]
[h1]=====🔧 The Reset 🔧====[/h1]
Leaving [b]Early Access[/b] means we need to clear some things so that all players can start this title all over at the same time. To put it simply: [b]all progress will be wiped[/b] - progress in missions and discovered forklifts and warehouses. Without it, we wouldn't be able to roll out the full update - which affects much of the game code.

We know that not everyone will accept such a message with a smile, but it is necessary for the [b]achievements[/b] and [b]leaderboards[/b] to work properly (out of many things). In return, however, you get a finished, polished, extensive COMPLETE game. We tried to find workarounds but we would risk the game stability and data corruption with Steam API. We hope it will not prevent you from continuing to enjoy being the [b]Best Forklift Operator[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/f99e2213989e28050e057bfa8ccbc5e1fbb70259.gif[/img]
[h1]=====🔧 The Hack 🔧====[/h1]
Life hack alert: However! The amount of money you have on your account in the [b]Early Access[/b] version [b]will be transferred[/b] to version 1.00, so if you want to make it easier to start the premiere edition of the game, [b]we suggest selling all forklifts[/b] before the update.

notes.title: 💬 Dev Diary #3 - Update 2
notes.content:
[h1]=====🔧 Overview 🔧====[/h1]
Dear forklift operators - thank you for supporting us, for waiting for this update, and for helping us choose what will be most important to you!

As you can see - this time we added some really important things to the game, things that you asked for from the very beginning of [b]Early Access[/b]. Thanks to the work of our team, in the current update we can communicate adding the [b]steering wheel[/b] support you requested so much, beta version of [b]VR goggles + other controllers[/b] support, We also introduced completely new control presets and improved button binding. The final surprise is that [b]Best Forklift Operator[/b] already supports [b]Point shop[/b] and [b]Community Items[/b]!

Beautiful news isn't it? And we'll be back soon with more 😘


[h1]=====🔧 Update Content 🔧====[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/2d9acbabaee608c0b6a4096351dcf0e67f3f46d1.jpg[/img]
[h3]🏁 Support for Steering Wheels & Pedals[/h3]
We are pleased to confirm that the game now supports steering wheels. We have prepared for the support of four specific, the most popular (tested and confirmed are: Thrustmaster Ferrari 458 (Xbox 360 model), Logitech G29, Thrustmaster T150 Racing Wheel & Thrustmaster T300 RS Racing Wheel) and general system support for other models. Now the forklift journey really begins!

Steering Wheel works in VR and non-VR mode (btw - in the menu, the steering wheel is detected as a gamepad).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/eb2841a8351492bc8911aa74a67a0bb9c17142b5.jpg[/img]
[h3]🥽 Virtual Reality mode + ANYTHING[/h3]
We listened to many of your voices - you often wanted to combine controlling various controllers (including steering wheels, gamepads, mouse, keyboard) with wearing VR goggles on your head. We have good news: You can now play Best Forklift Operator this way - but we also want to emphasize that this is a [b]beta version solution[/b]. 

The multitude of configurations and necessary tests mean that we cannot currently provide something that will support each hardware configuration. The game will start in this mode, but not every hardware (computer + headset) will work properly. 

The chances of it working properly are similar to the chance that you will get bugs, but knowing that we will be able to satisfy at least some of the players, we decided to add such a feature in this update. We'd love everything to work perfectly right away.

At present, however, it is not possible for us to further refine this solution. We ask for your understanding and we hope that most of you will be able to enjoy BFO exactly the way you want.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/67261ae59d275e047bc034bee2297ed6c0d6b44c.jpg[/img]
[h3]⌨️ Key Binding Presets + User Presets [/h3]
As the name suggests - we have added new versions of the controls preset to the game. Thanks to them, it will be easier for you to find the control method that will be the most suitable for you. And if that turned out to be not enough, you will assign functions to specific buttons yourself.

You will now find in the game three presets for the gamepad (and a fourth for customization), and three presets for the keyboard (and the fourth one for customization).

We hope that thanks to this Best Forklift Operator will become more accessible to everyone.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/368ca9686e9e1217dd4ad1089ce378f922ef95d1.jpg[/img]
[h3]🎴 Point Shop & Community Items[/h3]
Thanks to high rating and popularity - Valve enabled Steam Items for [b]Best Forklift Operator[/b] - wohow! So we instantly jumped in and tried our best to provide you with the most epic items we could think of. 

Some of them are very game-related some others stray a bit from the game's theme - but all of them had been carefully crafted to serve their ultimate purpose - being an awesome decoration for your user profiles. Now, let's have a closer look at the goods 😽

🎁 Point Shop Items - Animated Avatars
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/73e04e36263620b485ec7b49fc9f7dc17024f47a.gif[/img]

🎁 Point Shop Items - Animated Avatar Frames
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/7483535c3343db9757fae9daa9142d0c510feda5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/0d0979a1f1026ab78d0cabc861f3b48e80d3159b.gif[/img]

🎁 Point Shop Items - Stickers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/c53d211e1985c69698b34143e0a00d87dae200df.gif[/img]

🎁 Community Items - Badges
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/6acaa44701a18622a7a3ef05ea4f706f6e975dfb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/adbb4c7b4619c382e2f85b0145ff2b791a5e88b7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/c0226d5a92948df70cc414716ff7792592269272.gif[/img]

You can check all the Point Shop items ➡️[url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1684670] HERE [/url]⬅️ 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/58c1f84f8dddd7b3d516e63c781a95a6e4ca8143.jpg[/img]
[h3]🗣 German Language Localization[/h3]
It's that simple - you can play in German! (full text localization) / So einfach ist das – Sie können auf Deutsch spielen!

[h1]=====🔧 End Note 🔧====[/h1]
There are still some important things to do. More updates are coming, increasing the content of the game itself, and diversifying what you have already seen. We hope that you will stay with us even longer to see how we bring this project to an end. 

Once again, thank you very much for your support, commitment, and suggestions that you send to us. We want Best Forklift Operator to bring joy to players, and to make it an interesting title among other simulators. With your help, everything is possible!

notes.title: 💬 Dev Diary #2 - Update 1
notes.content:
[h1]=====🔧 Overview 🔧====[/h1]
Our dear friends in warehouses and forklifts around the world - we want to [b]thank you[/b] again for your commitment to [b]Best Forklift Operator[/b].

The first update is live and brings you some of the things you really cared about. The game now offers support for [b]HTC Vive[/b] (Wands), and [b]Valve Index[/b] (Knuckles) goggles & controllers! This means that even more people will be able to try how BFO performs in VR (and we know from many of you that this is a great, immersive experience).

In addition, the game now supports new, [b]higher display resolutions[/b] (above full HD), and we have introduced a more intuitive, [b]user-friendly pointer to the VR[/b] version. We also improved the issues that made the game crash at first for some users.

[h1]=====🔧 Update Content 🔧====[/h1]
[h3]🥽 Support for HTC Vive+Wands &Valve Index+Knuckles[/h3]
Now you can do some delicious forklifting with those bad boys too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/db2969e1fd7c788ade333b126cb953fa3cd91046.jpg[/img]

[h3]🖥️ Higher display resolutions[/h3]
Confirmed resolutions are 21:9 - 2560×1080,
21:9 - 3440×1440,
16:9 - 2560×1440
and 16:9 - 3840×2160.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/8dcece660f818c6f61e12046b1cdef94c3d0b34b.jpg[/img]

[h3]👨🏻‍💻 Other Goodies[/h3]
- Pointer (for VR mode)
- Fixed the crashing bug 
- Fixed visual artifacts of 3d models in some parts of warehouses
- Cargo models optimization
- Fixed "two same hands"
- Changed interface interactions in VR (to be more comfortable)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/2210a8e83bab10b63b345586f80f7dc70e9b7b52.jpg[/img]

[h1]=====🔧 Work in Progress 🔧====[/h1]
- Support for Steering Wheels
- A brand new Warehouse and missions
- More cargo types
- Upgrading and expanding current Warehouses
- Community & Point Shop Items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/f215bc5813657975efe509a3932e0d854a6050ff.jpg[/img]

[h1]=====🔧 End Note 🔧====[/h1]
We hope you will continue to follow us and support our efforts to bring you the best forklift simulator on the market. We are working on making the game better and better and making the 1.00 version a great product for everyone to have a good time with.

Thank you again! 

Want to always be up to date with the game?
Remember to click the "[b]Follow[/b]" button on the storepage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/4e03ad9172743913a523174bf94352784e4498c3.jpg[/img]

PS We are currently working on a roadmap that we will be able to publish so that you know what the next updates will bring.
[i]~Gamedust[/i]

notes.content:
We are so excited to present the next [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352020]Yupitergrad[/url] levels and show you our most [b]twisted visions[/b]!

[b]Twisted Levels[/b] Update brings  [b]ten new levels[/b] to [b]Time Attack[/b] mode. They offer unusual challenges and tracks made with [b]pure love[/b] to the game. The experience of breaking new speed records will be even more suggestive and will give you a real adrenaline rush. [b]For real[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34050739/86592f7d26040dc564274167c55bda5fdd8d602f.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34050739/ab000df259e6ec783db52a2dcd1a18b01a6bae46.gif[/img]

Now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352020]Yupitergrad[/url] has a campaign mode, [b]Gymnasion [/b]mode that allows anyone to warm up, and [b]50 Time Attack[/b] routes. This is a package that we are really proud of, and we are glad that [b]you are with us on this adventure[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34050739/3a28dbc36c520ee27f17cba74cd0e98a580cf5d2.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34050739/55b2b43c96ea27ff14d26e41194e0fe275af085e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34050739/56e88c85094c26e9513c1c657511164a260e38b5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34050739/a0c444e00d48a64991c00509d370f1adf66c01fc.png[/img]

Thank you again for being with us, stay safe and fly high!
